trails.title: Data Supplementation
trails.description: Please extract and record the useful content from this videotape.

content.text:
...

"Check it out! You are witnessing the greatest rock moment of all time, brought to you by the one and only Rockin' Captain!"

"Keep it down, Researcher Regulus! I'm recording this!"

"Hey, we could die at any second! No way I'm gonna stay silent!"

"Then just keep yelling! We'll keep the control variables consistent! Now, start testing the next material! Researcher Regulus, put down the Dragon Blood Resin Compass and pick up the Platinum Ouija!"

"Yeah! How's this?! Have I become a work of art yet?!"

"As with the previous material tests, Researcher Regulus's temporary 'Storm' symptoms have shown no improvement! The Platinum Ouija is ruled out! This concludes the testing of the single-material objects. Next, let's move on to the two-material objects!"

...

items.text: In the cramped broadcasting room, the little lion and the lightbulb are at a face-off.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: What did you say?
Her unexpected declaration has caused the ferrofluid to come to a halt.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You heard me, you daft lightbulb! I will not be your undertaker!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Regulus, you still haven't grasped the significance of this project, have you?!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: We've figured out the principles of the "Storm" and even developed the means to create its simulacra! Yes, there's still much room for improvement, but we've already made a huge leap!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: And now, we finally have the opportunity to put our theories into application!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Finding an immutable material is essential to our survival! The "Regulus Satellite" proved it to all of us!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Just think about it, Regulus.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: We are standing right on the cusp of the post-"Storm" era!
Regulus hangs her head.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Fish Tank.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You planned this all along, didn't you?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Don't tell me you're worried about the funds and credit for the experiment?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Laplace will cover all your potential losses and expenses incurred should anything go wrong.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: And whether this project succeeds or not, your assistance has been indispensable. Surely enough to earn you a fat bonus and a high rating for your salary review, and I will certainly not be hogging all the credit.
Ulrich stops upon seeing an even more resolute expression come across Regulus's face.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa, no, keep it in the tank!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: You've got me all wrong, Magnet Head.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Huh?
The two exchanged stunned looks.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I'm a member of Laplace now, same as you. A researcher, not just an observer.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I, too, witnessed the "Storm."
Ulrich has never seen Regulus so earnest.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So, ergo, therefore, Q.E.D., I'll participate in your "Artificial Storm" experiment, not as your note taker.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But as your fellow experimenter!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I never expected this from you, Regulus.
He knocks on his glass tank, perplexed.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Don't tell me my reports were really that bad.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Never mind, really, don't tell me. Fact of the matter is, I got an advance on my wages, so I fully intend to do my duty as a researcher!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Besides ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No rockin' pirate with a spine would ever leave their shipmates stranded in danger.
Ulrich squeezes Regulus's shoulder.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I admire your courage, truly.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: However, when it comes to these experiments, you must leave it to me!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: That is an order, Regulus.
His resolve is unyielding.
He opens the door, signaling Regulus to leave his "lab."

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I need you to observe my status through the porthole and record our experimental data. You're the only one that can do it.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Alright, Magnet Head, have it your way.
Her eyes linger on the experimental materials in the case.
Platinum Ouija boards, young dragon tongue tubes, fire moth powder, and numerous duplicated records ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Say Ulrich, do you like rock?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Now is hardly the time to chat about music, don't you think?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I hope you won't be pestering me with more of these inane questions.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: And to answer you, I prefer Brown noise. Its frequencies produce a soothing rhythm in my ferrofluid.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: See? That's exactly why I can't leave it to you.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Errr. What?
This logical leap nearly causes Ulrich's circuits to crash.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I turned a blind eye to your blatant acts of piracy ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: And brushed off your blasphemies against rock.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But, if I miss out on an adventure like this,

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I'll forever lose the right to join the 27 Club!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: The 27 Club?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: All the best rock stars die at 27, or in a blaze of glory!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This is my record, my responsibility.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: We might fall or even vanish.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Maybe we'll get turned into cubes or paint or whatever!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But at the end of the day ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Rock never dies!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Whether you're a rock legend or not, you shine with the radiance of humanity.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Regulus, I salute both your experimental spirit and your rock 'n' roll spirit!

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: There's only one thing left to do.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Project: Experiments on Material Immutability via "Artificial Storm"

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Locale: Radio Room of the "Free Breeze" Cruise Ship

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Experimenters: Ulrich and Regulus

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Our experiment will now commence.
